{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of baseline biomarker values by sex
biomarker_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].describe()

# Check the distribution of severity by sex and arm
severity_by_sex_arm = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], [trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity']])

# Check the distribution of sites by sex and arm
site_by_sex_arm = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], [trial_df['arm'], trial_df['site']])

# Check the distribution of assay batches by sex and arm
batch_by_sex_arm = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], [trial_df['arm'], trial_df['assay_batch']])

biomarker_by_sex, severity_by_sex_arm, site_by_sex_arm, batch_by_sex_arm"}
